column1: # INV-T-4909. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-85, 331, 333, 335, 877, 956, 1245
# (read from Keel). One row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it; INV-REQ-333 names the
# three Excluded values and excludedBusinessStatus, INV-REQ-335 names obligationStartDate.
# INV-T-8106 adds one row, OffboardTenantRequest.secondConfirmationBy (INV-REQ-875). The other names of INV-REQ-875 and INV-AC-8105 add no row:
# entity.admin, tenant.admin, tax.approver (roles); entity-config.confirm (a permission of the catalogue table of INV-T-7987);
# Not listed, because they are not tenancy contract identifiers: entity.admin, tenant.admin, tax.approver (roles);
# tenancy-svc, console-bff, console-web, config-resolver (services); setPolicy (owning services' contracts);
# confirmFiling (submission/openapi.yaml); applyOperatingProfile (INV-REQ-1245) belongs to console-bff (owner answer
# to INV-Q-5022). recordAppliedOperatingProfile and getAppliedOperatingProfile are the two rows added by INV-Q-5035.
# Named by other requirements, not by the seven this task implements, and owned by another service's contract:
# AggregateReady (aggregation/asyncapi.yaml; INV-REQ-437, 1205); NOT_SUBMITTABLE (catalogue and the ingestion, rules,
# canonical, payload and submission contracts; INV-REQ-75, 78); approvePack (rules/openapi.yaml; INV-REQ-772, 995);
# acknowledgeControlRelaxation (no contract defines it yet; INV-REQ-1244, 1252, 2588: a later task for the owning service).

# INV-T-8140 adds five rows (INV-REQ-8100): openTenant, OpenTenantRequest.scheduleRef and the three TenantStateResponse.state members. The other names of INV-REQ-8100, INV-REQ-987 and INV-AC-8139 add no row:
# commercial.admin (a role); goLive, offboardTenant, createEntity, certifySandbox (rows that exist); `tenant not open` (a phrase, not an identifier).
# INV-T-8178 adds three rows (INV-REQ-8100): closeTenant, CloseTenantRequest.scheduleRef and CloseTenantRequest.retentionCustodyHolder. The other names of INV-REQ-8100 and INV-AC-8177 add no row:
# offboardTenant (a row that exists); tenant.admin, entity.admin, finance.viewer, commercial.admin (roles); noticeWindowDays (an optional property).

# INV-T-8754 adds ten rows: assessPhase, AssessPhaseRequest.returns and .extrapolate, PhaseAssessmentResponse.totalAnnualSupplies, .inputs and the members PHASE_4 to PHASE_6 (INV-REQ-334), SetEntityStatusRequest.registrationStartDate and EntityStatusResponse.registrationStartDate (INV-REQ-335).
# INV-T-7645. Baseline rows of the audited operations (INV-REQ-2588 behavior 1) of tenancy that existed without a row.

# INV-T-9735. Period generation contract: the proposal in the changeFilingFrequency response and the FREQUENCY_CHANGE kind (INV-REQ-83, 84, 708). entity.admin and tax.approver are roles; tenancy-svc is a service; confirmPeriodReassignment belongs to canonical/openapi.yaml.
# INV-T-9770 adds five rows (INV-REQ-987): the entity-scope answers of answerQuestionnaire. goLive and the other names of INV-REQ-987 belong to the tasks that carry them.

# INV-T-8695 adds two rows (INV-REQ-1386): CreateTenantRequest.dataRegion and TenantResponse.dataRegion. The other names of INV-AC-1331 and INV-AC-8572 add no row: provisionTenant (an operation of the control-plane contract that exists).

# INV-T-9835 adds ten rows (INV-REQ-878, INV-REQ-879; INV-Q-11882 A). The checker has no kind for a bare schema name, so EntityUsage and RecordEntitlementRequest are carried by schema_property rows (the schema must exist in components.schemas and own the property); plain property rows for planVersion, maxEntities and maxDocumentsPerMonth are not added because EntitlementResponse satisfies them. The other names add no row: UsageCountersResponse, activeEntities, documentsThisPeriod, getUsageCounters, tenantRef (rows already on main), SubmissionAcknowledged (an event of the submission contract), tenancy-svc (a service), 429 (a status code), billing.contact (a role of the access permission catalogue).

# INV-T-9836 adds ten rows (INV-REQ-907, INV-REQ-1313, INV-REQ-1095; INV-Q-9821 A, INV-Q-9823 A, INV-Q-9825 A). The checker has no kind for a bare schema name, so ElectPlatformRequest, PlatformElectionResponse and InstallationFactsRequest are carried by schema_property rows. The other names add no row: LicenceResponse, licenceId, status, expiresAt, installLicence, InstallationStatusChanged, depCode, recordInstallationAction (rows or definitions already on main); LicenceCheck, owns, deployment.operator, billing.contact, tenancy-svc (not carried by this contract).
